get_log.name: Read panel log
get_log.description: Reads a log from the SPC panel and returns its entries, newest first. Administrators only. Card data and undecoded panel fields are not returned; the panel's texts are returned as written. The panel always sends the whole log; the limit only shortens the result.

config_entry_id.name: Panel
config_entry_id.description: SPC FlexC panel. Needed only when there are several.

id.name: ID
id.description: Door number for the access log, zone number for the zone log, ATS number for the ATS event log.

atp.name: ATP
atp.description: ATP number within the ATS, for the ATP logs (default 1).

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return.
